exposure: Epidural sufentanil (5, 10, 15, 20, and 25 mug) as an adjuvant with 10 mL of 0.65% ropivacaine
outcome: Effective dose (ED50) and 95% effective dose (ED95) of epidural sufentanil for relief visceral pain
cohort: 100 parturients with scarred uterus undergoing elective cesarean section under epidural anesthesia
finding: Epidural sufentanil between 15 mug and 20 mug, in combination with ropivacaine, maximized patient satisfaction for relief from somato-visceral pain during elective cesarean section.
